voice: Upbeat, quick, friendly male coach, brisk pace, energetic, no long pauses.
music: Upbeat light electronic instrumental for a quick fitness explainer, punchy drums, bright synth plucks, 124 BPM, about 20 seconds, clean ending, stays quiet under a voice.

script.intro: Did you know you're taller in the morning?
script.outro: Thirty seconds, then eight hours of sleep.

sections.name: Spine
sections.say: At night your spine decompresses. Child's pose before bed helps it let go.

clips.shot: Full body side view, child's pose on a black mat: kneeling, hips back on the heels, arms stretched far forward, forehead near the mat, long rounded back; the whole spine and lower back glow. Figure in the lower-middle of the frame
clips.move: a child's pose stretch, reaching the arms further forward on each slow breath while the hips sink back

clips.shot: Rear 3/4 view from above, child's pose on a black mat, arms reaching forward, the spine visibly lengthening; the spinal muscles glow intensely along the whole back
clips.move: slow deep breaths in child's pose, the back lengthening and relaxing
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right
